Overview

Dublin is a city in Dublin with a population of 1,270,000. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 145 sunny days a year.
